messages:
Caleb: Quick sync / ask  we're locking the social schedule for next Wed launch. Need: hero still (16:9), 1:1 crop, short teaser MP4, two caption tracks (benchmark vs developer), UTMs, and 3 snappy replies per track. Assets by EOD?
Mei: Yep  uploading now to s3://redwood-marketing/launch/1827777777/ as `hero_16x9_v1.png`, `hero_1x1_v1.png`, `teaser_6s.mp4`. README in the folder with alt text.
Jordan: I'll draft copy variants. Variant A = numbers-first (latency/cost), Variant B = product-first (integration + SDKs). Will keep X replies <140 chars and LI longer.
SchedulerBot: Scheduling window reserved Wed 08:00-11:30 PT. No conflicts detected.
Caleb: CTA: primary = "Get early access". Pinned reply CTA for X = "Save your seat: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=launch_1827". HubSpot form -> list `launch_1827_social`. Webhook to `#leads-launch`. Tag leads `source:social_1827`.
Mei: Uploaded an optimized GIF fallback `teaser_fallback.gif` and added suggested captions. File sizes in README.
Jordan: Draft micro-replies (Benchmark):
- A1: "Which model/seq did you benchmark?"
- A2: "Nice numbers  can you share the config?"
- A3: "Want a quick demo clip?"
Draft micro-replies (Developer):
- B1: "How long to integrate end-to-end?"
- B2: "Any SDK examples?"
- B3: "Hosted or private options?"
Caleb: Shorten replies for X (drop articles). Pin webinar CTA in first reply. Mei / Jordan  final copy + pinned reply by 4pm please.
HubBot: HubSpot mapping verified: form `hs_1827` -> list `launch_1827_social`. Webhook to `#leads-launch` active. Tag rule `source:social_1827` added.
Mei: Final assets and copy posted in the folder and pasted here. Queue held until Caleb signs off.
Caleb: Reviewing now. If no blockers I will approve at 5pm and SchedulerBot can release. After publish monitor first 45m; if CTR <1.2% we seed retargeting audience and notify SDRs.
Jordan: Got it. Will post final micro-replies adjusted for X length by 3:45pm.
Caleb: Thanks team  aiming for a clean lead flow and tidy UTMs.
